digest.component_or_area: review-bot LLM provider cutover from Anthropic API to AWS Bedrock
propositions: The production LLM-Review gate must be cut over from direct Anthropic API to AWS Bedrock inference profiles for dogfooding purposes, with per-pass model class slots (frontier/standard/trivial) configured independently to preserve the existing Pass-1 opus / Pass-2,4 sonnet split.

The review-bot container image does not currently install the bedrock provider package extra, causing the first Bedrock call to fail with LLMConfigError if the class slots are set without adding --extra bedrock to the uv sync command.

A multi-layered safety net must be proven operational before the cutover takes effect: the VOTER_ERROR alarm chain must transition from OK to ALARM when the gate fails, and the bedrock provider import must resolve inside the running container.

The kill switch (reverting the class slots to unset state) restores the pre-cutover Anthropic path via built-in class defaults, but requires the shared ANTHROPIC_API_KEY credential to remain in the container despite being unused on the Bedrock path.

Bedrock receives botocore stock client defaults for retry and timeout handling, not the tenacity-based retry envelope available on the Anthropic path, creating an unmet parity gap for configurable retry behavior.
